summary: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) College of Graduate Studies gives Graduate Research Fellowships to eligible international PhD students. The fellowship is a partial package: it includes a full tuition waiver and health insurance (for international students, only when UAEU sponsors the visa). Holders must study full-time, work at least 10 hours a week as a research assistant to their supervisor and publish one paper in a refereed, indexed journal. It runs for up to 4 years.
eligibility_notes:
The fellowship is for international PhD students at UAEU. All applicants must enrol full-time in at least 9 graduate credits per semester, must not be financially sponsored by any other organisation and must hold no active employment. They must have a GPA of 3.5 or higher in the master's degree, and must keep a GPA of 3.5 or higher at PhD level.

For international students the selection also considers the ranking and research classification of the institution that awarded the master's degree, the applicant's earlier research experience and how relevant it is to UAEU research, and the publication record.

Opportunities are normally available when a student is admitted to the PhD programme. The number of awards each year depends on available funds. UAEU says in general that all scholarships and fellowships depend on budget and that meeting the minimum requirements does not guarantee approval.

To be admitted to the PhD, applicants must also meet the general PhD admission rules: a master's degree with cumulative GPA 3.0 out of 4.0 or equivalent and a bachelor's degree with 2.5 out of 4.0 or equivalent, both from accredited universities recognised by the UAE Ministry of Education; IELTS Academic 6.5 or higher (or equivalent) for English-taught programmes or an English dissertation, with a score less than two years old; and any higher or extra standards that individual colleges set. English test exemptions exist for native English speakers with a master's from an English-medium institution in an English-speaking country, and for applicants who show IELTS Academic 6.0 or equivalent at admission to an English-medium master's.
age_experience_notes: No age limit is stated. Prior research experience and publications count in selection, but no minimum amount of experience is stated.
funding_summary: The award is a partial package of a full tuition waiver and health insurance. It lasts a maximum of 4 years. A faculty member can ask for an extension with documented justification: the fellowship page says one semester, the parent fellowship page says up to two semesters, requested in the final semester of the award. The award stays valid only if the student meets the eligibility rules every semester and receives a very good performance appraisal from the supervisor. If a holder takes official leave, the stipend and any housing allowance are suspended and the award period is extended by the leave period. The pages name a stipend and a housing allowance in the leave rule but give no amount for either.
programmes_note: The fellowship pages name no fields and set no discipline restriction. The list below is UAEU's list of PhD programmes (26 programmes; the first 25 in source order are shown, the 26th is Doctor of Philosophy in Physics). The pages do not say whether every programme is covered by this fellowship. The fellowship itself needs full-time study.
institutions_note: The fellowship is held only at the United Arab Emirates University; the PhD programmes in the 2026-2027 deadlines document are offered in Al Ain.

summary.detail: International PhD students, full-time (at least 9 graduate credits per semester). Award up to 4 years with full tuition waiver and health insurance (international students only if UAEU sponsors the visa). Duties: at least 10 hours per week as research assistant throughout the year, and one paper in a refereed, indexed journal in the research discipline. Teaching language is not stated on the fellowship pages.

application_steps.title: Contact the college or department you want to join
application_steps.detail: UAEU advises applicants to contact the college or department they wish to join before applying. Check that your master's GPA is at least 3.5 and that you can study full-time with no other sponsor or job.

application_steps.title: Apply online for PhD admission and prepare the documents
application_steps.detail: Apply for the PhD through the UAEU online application portal with the certified degree certificates and transcripts, the Ministry of Education equivalency letter, English test, two recommendation letters, CV, passport copy and photo. The 2026-2027 deadlines document lists the PhD dates for Fall 2027 as TBA (not yet announced); it also says complete applications received after the deadline go to the next cycle.

application_steps.title: Complete and submit the fellowship application form
application_steps.detail: Fill in the Graduate Research Scholarship/Fellowship application form and submit it with all required documents. Fellowships are normally offered at the time of admission to the PhD programme. The pages state no fellowship deadline.

application_steps.title: Admission and fellowship selection
application_steps.detail: Applicants must meet the GPA rules, and selection also looks at the ranking and research classification of the master's institution, research experience relevant to UAEU research, and publications. The number of awards depends on available funds and meeting the minimum does not guarantee approval.

application_steps.title: Do the research-assistant work and publish a paper
application_steps.detail: Holders work at least 10 hours per week through the year as a research assistant for the faculty supervisor, publish one paper in a refereed, indexed journal in their discipline, and take part in research-training activities where possible. Other paid work is allowed only at UAEU (for example teaching or administrative assistant), up to 10 hours per week in total, with written permission from the fellowship supervisor sent to the College of Graduate Studies.

application_steps.title: Keep the award each semester
application_steps.detail: Each semester the supervisor sends an evaluation to the College of Graduate Studies and the student must get a very good appraisal, stay full-time with at least 9 credits and keep a GPA of 3.5 or higher. A student who fails a condition loses the award automatically and is told by the College. The award lasts up to 4 years, with a possible extension requested by a faculty member with justification, and is extended by the length of any approved official leave.
